entry.title: MoonClaw modeling proposals for First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
entry.summary: critical ephemeris-acquisition job: Replace relief-shadow and zero-available-energy proxies with time-windowed solar ephemeris evidence before Moonrobo simulation is allowed.

primary_proposal.title: Attach ephemeris-backed power and thermal windows
primary_proposal.objective: Replace relief-shadow and zero-available-energy proxies with time-windowed solar ephemeris evidence before Moonrobo simulation is allowed.

inputs.summary: Conservative rover energy budget currently blocks because no verified sunlit power window is attached.
Per-route illumination gates use measured relief as a shadow-risk proxy and require time-windowed replacement evidence.
Pinned LOLA product label gives the site projection and bounds needed to request matching ephemeris products.

acceptance_criteria.description: Name the ephemeris or illumination source family, citation, local evidence path, checksum, and temporal coverage window.
Compute sunlit hours, expected generation Wh, dark-survival Wh, and margin for the selected route window.
Update the MoonBit energy and illumination assessments and add tests that prove Moonrobo remains blocked or becomes reviewable for cited reasons.

proposals.title: Promote the LOLA route-corridor search
proposals.objective: Promote the pinned 9x9 corridor ranking and prove whether the bounded site remains blocked before any route candidate is handed to Moonrobo.

inputs.summary: Current ranked 9x9 corridor scan measures 81 windows; the best window selects northeast-stepout and still blocks on conservative route limits.
Current named route candidates remain blocked; northeast-stepout is the selected route fixture for the best 9x9 measured window.
Existing byte-range extraction pattern for adding adjacent LOLA evidence windows.

acceptance_criteria.description: Publish the search radius, sampled windows, ordering rule, CSV checksum, and generator command.
Return at least one lower-risk route candidate or a measured proof that every sampled window remains blocked.
Refresh MoonBook route, corridor, and MoonClaw proposal payloads so the operator can audit the 9x9 result as files.

proposals.title: Score route candidates after terrain and power evidence improves
proposals.objective: Combine terrain, corridor, illumination, and energy evidence into a route-scoring receipt that Moonmoon can validate before Moonrobo consumes a simulation precondition packet.

inputs.summary: All current route alternatives with terrain score, confidence, and next action.
Robot-facing precondition packets that must remain blocked until Moonmoon evidence clears the gates.
MoonBook review state that records which blockers need evidence or operator attention.

acceptance_criteria.description: Emit a receipt with sorted candidates, decision rationale, rejected assumptions, and exact evidence paths used for each score.
Moonmoon validates the receipt against current route IDs, review items, and source checksums before accepting it.
The accepted scoring result must explain whether the primary Moonrobo handoff remains blocked, moves to review, or becomes allowed.
